verdict.rationale: incident.io documents user-configured Workflows that automatically take actions, such as auto-publishing to a status page when an incident is updated. It also documents AI Investigations that start on their own the moment an incident is declared and keep re-assessing as new signals arrive, plus two-way ticket sync that runs without manual steps. These are event-triggered background automations, not recurring schedules. Missing for 10: in-depth Workflows documentation in the pack (trigger/condition/step configuration), evidence of scheduled or recurring automations, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background

citations.quote: With Workflows, you can automatically publish to your status page when an incident is updated.
The moment an incident is declared, an investigation gathers context from across your stack
Investigations runs on a purpose-built harness that re-assesses as new signals land
You can now configure incident tickets to update the incident when the ticket changes, as well as updating the ticket when the incident changes.
